messages:
nina: Following up on the postmortem for the cache-eviction recurrence. We need a tight runbook change: a 5-step quick triage, a set of copy-paste ops commands, and a clear escalation matrix with timeboxes and owners. Who can take what?

sam: I can draft the 5-step triage. Draft: 1) confirm scope (single model vs cluster), 2) snapshot kvcache hit/miss, 3) inspect eviction events & reason codes, 4) apply short mitigation (shard tweak or fallback route), 5) tag incident + notify. Will make each step one line.

trent: I'll add exact commands for the runbook. Proposed text to paste: ```bash
# recent eviction events
redwoodctl telemetry events list --type=eviction --since 30m --format json

# kvcache hit-rate
redwoodctl metrics query "increase(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_requests_total[5m])"

# tail runtime logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=15m | tail -n 200

# fallback: route to smaller model
redwoodctl route set --model model-compact --traffic 100% --reason "eviction-fallback"
```

hema: Escalation proposal: oncall ack <10m, eng-sre engaged <20m if not mitigated, eng-runtime notified <45m, leads + customer-sre CC'd at 90m. I'll own the role-based contact table and confirm primary/secondary for each role.

ops-bot: Incident linked: INC-2026-1510. Reminder: runbook PRs due in 6 days.

sam: Mitigation snippets I'll add: if hit-rate drop >25% + eviction spike -> increase kvcache shard_limit by 15% and restart cache pods one-by-one. If eviction reason == "oom" -> reduce model batch size or route traffic to model-compact. Example: `redwoodctl config patch kvcache --shard-limit +15% --reason "mitigation"`.

trent: I'll include example log matches to make triage faster (eviction_reason=kv_overbudget, OOM stack snippets). Also a tiny troubleshooting table: eviction_reason -> suggested next step.

carlos: Assign owners and deadlines: sam -> 5-step triage + mitigation snippets (due in 2bd), trent -> ops commands + sample outputs (due in 3bd), hema -> escalation matrix + contact table (due in 4bd). I'll schedule a 20m review 48 hours from now.

nina: One playbook rule to add: when unsure, reduce traffic to the suspect model before mass restarts. Flag repeaters for deeper investigation.

sam: ACK. I'll open a PR in `playbooks/` and link it here.

trent: ACK. I'll paste verified outputs in the PR and include copyable commands.

op-bot: Reminder set: PR review check in 72 hours.

carlos: Summary (copyable):
- sam: triage doc + mitigations (2bd)
- trent: commands + telemetry + outputs (3bd)
- hema: escalation matrix + contacts (4bd)
Please reply to confirm ownership. :white_check_mark:
